text:
Vik (release-lead): Heads-up team: holding a 6-hour embargo starting 23:30 UTC for deprecation rollout and schema compatibility checks. Affected areas: public SDKs, api-gateway routing rules, and feature-flag service. Please do not merge changes that touch deprecations or flags during the window.
Nate (eng): Ack. Does this pause all model rollouts or just feature-flag related changes?
Vik (release-lead): Only deprecation/flags/schema-related changes. Model runtime and infra continue on normal cadence. If your PR touches migration flags, mark it `deprec/hold` and coordinate with me.
Ivy (oncall): Escalation thresholds: if client-facing 4xx increases by >2% or if auth failures spike >0.4% for 5m, auto-revert and page oncall.
Sara (compliance): We're running a compatibility probe against older SDK versions in parallel. If the probe finds breaking changes, we will extend embargo and require a hotfix. I'll post probe status updates here.
ReleaseBot: Action: embargo_applied [deprecations, flags, schema] by Vik at 23:33 UTC. CI hooks for affected services suspended.
Nate (eng): Need a short exception process for urgent security fixes that touch flags?
Vik (release-lead): Yes: escalate to me + Sara via DM, include a rollback plan and convince both approvers. ReleaseBot will require `exception/approved` tag before merge.
Sara (compliance): Compatibility probe: starting run 1 (older SDK matrix). Initial pass ETA 45m. Will post failures if any.
Ivy (oncall): Dashboard link: https://dash.internal.redwood/boards/deprec-compat. I'll watch error budgets and run synthetic checks on client SDKs.
Nate (eng): Will postpone a partner-facing change that flips a flag; will reopen when you lift embargo.
ReleaseBot: Note: changelog guidance: add a one-line entry under "Release Train" for any change related to deprecations and reference ticket DEP-240.
Vik (release-lead): Plan: embargo start 23:30 -> compatibility probe -> decision by 02:00 UTC whether to lift or extend. I'll post an interim status at 01:00 UTC and final lift notice after verification. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
